ShortDescription.Value: Simulate district elections with custom parties, monthly polls, and a results map.

Publish.LongDescription:
Once your city has a City Hall, it holds elections on a schedule you choose, and every district reports its own result. Turnout and vote choice come from the citizens who actually live there: their age, education, wealth and job.
- A district results map colored by winner and shaded by margin - Votes, shares, turnout, and approval for your city's districts - A party editor for names, colors, and political positions - An election archive that saves with your city by default - Monthly polls between elections, based on the game's own happiness
No other mods required, and nothing changes traffic or time.

ChangeLog.Value: Initial release with district elections, editable parties, monthly polls, election history, and a results map.
